title: Modules
description: Optional features built into Aphel. Enable only what your organization uses: disabling stops the module's screens and routines, but its data is kept.
emptyDescription: This Aphel build includes no modules.
updateAvailableHint: This organization runs version {{installed}}; Aphel ships version {{version}}.

dependents.title: Used by
dependents.hint: Disable the modules that depend on this one first: {{names}}.

disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.description: The module's screens, menus, widgets and automatic routines stop working for the whole organization. No data is deleted: enabling it again restores everything.

settings.title: Configure {{name}}
settings.description: Settings apply to the whole organization. Secrets are encrypted and never shown again.
settings.noFields: This module has no generic settings.
settings.requiredHint: Fill in the required fields to enable the module.
settings.secretConfigured: Already configured. Leave blank to keep the current value.
settings.extraPanelDisabled: Enable the module to see the other options.

validation.url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
validation.unknown: This setting does not exist in this module.

purge.title: Remove {{name}} data
purge.description: Permanently deletes all data stored by the module in this organization.
purge.warning: This cannot be undone. Removed data can only be recovered from the exported file.
purge.exportStep: Before removing, export the data to keep a copy.

errors.module_incompatible: This module is not compatible with the current Aphel version or its dependencies.
errors.module_dependency_disabled: Enable the modules this one depends on first.
errors.module_settings_required: Fill in the required settings before enabling.
errors.module_required_by: Other enabled modules depend on this one. Disable them first.
errors.module_enabled: Disable the module before removing its data.
errors.module_export_required: Export the data after disabling the module before removing it.
errors.module_confirmation_required: The typed key does not match.
errors.actionFailed: The action could not be completed
errors.generic: Could not save. Please try again.

plugins.noDeclarations: This plugin declares no additional resources.
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Third-party extensions installed from an .aphelplugin package, without rebuilding or restarting Aphel. They run isolated and only reach what the plugin API allows.
plugins.backendFailedDescription: This plugin's backend no longer loads, so writes to the record types it hooks are blocked. Reinstall the plugin package to unblock them.
plugins.emptyDescription: Upload an .aphelplugin file to add entities, fields, rules and screens to Aphel.
plugins.uninstallDescription: The plugin, the entities it created (with their records) and the fields it added to other types will be removed.
plugins.settingsDescription: Values the plugin uses. Secrets are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
plugins.secretConfigured: Configured. Leave blank to keep it.
plugins.secretWillClear: The secret will be removed when you save.
plugins.consentDescription: Review what the plugin asks for. It will act with these permissions, limited to yours, including in events, scheduled routines and public routes.
plugins.consentNothing: The plugin does not ask for any special permission.
plugins.consentPublicWarning: Public routes can be called by anyone on the internet, without signing in.
plugins.consentHttpWarning: The plugin will be able to send CRM data to the listed addresses.
plugins.presetsDescription: Select the roles the plugin should create with its suggested permissions. Nothing is selected by default; existing roles only receive missing grants.
plugins.grantsIncomplete: Some roles are missing or do not have every permission the plugin expects. Create the roles in Settings › Roles and reapply the grants.
plugins.consentConflictsTitle: This plugin overlaps with plugins already installed
plugins.consentConflictsDescription: The plugins below touch the same things and may contradict each other.
plugins.consentConflictsAck: I understand these plugins contradict each other and want to continue
plugins.consentModuleDisables: This plugin disables the {{name}} module while it is installed. The module is enabled again when the plugin is uninstalled.
plugins.consentModuleBlocked: The {{name}} module cannot be disabled right now: {{blockedBy}}.
